title: Grow the farm
tagline: Credit that follows the harvest, crops and greenhouses insured, and the sustainability data buyers ask for.
trigger: Seasonal income from an auction (veiling) and regular payments to farm suppliers.

steps.title: Your cash flow over the seasons
steps.description: A forecast of the lean and the rich months, from your auction income and supplier payments, compared with your sector.
steps.why: Based on your own account. Nothing is shared.

win.customer: No cash squeeze before the harvest

steps.result: Seasonal forecast ready: the tightest month is shown with the amount to bridge (illustrative).

steps.title: Credit that follows the harvest
steps.description: Agroflex Credit: draw when you sow, repay when the auction pays.
steps.why: Repayments follow your seasons instead of fixed months.

win.customer: Repay when the money comes in

steps.result: Agroflex Credit proposal ready, matched to your seasonal forecast.

steps.title: Crops and greenhouses insured
steps.description: Agriculture and horticulture insurance, including greenhouse cover against storm and hail.
steps.why: One storm can wipe out a season's income.

win.customer: A bad season doesn't end the farm

steps.result: Cover reviewed: greenhouse storm and hail cover proposed.

steps.title: Cheaper energy from your own roofs
steps.description: Solar panels and a battery on barn or greenhouse roofs, financed with an energy loan.
steps.why: Large roofs and daytime use make farms a strong fit for solar.
steps.result: Solar estimate ready for your roofs, with a financing proposal (illustrative).

steps.title: The sustainability data buyers ask for
steps.description: Retailers and auctions increasingly ask growers for ESG and CO2 figures. Kube ESG prepares them once.
steps.why: Kube ESG only receives your name, e-mail and company details, never your bank data.
steps.result: Kube ESG profile ready: your CO2 figures for buyers are pre-filled.

steps.title: Talk it through with your relationship manager
steps.description: Investments in machines or land, and the plan for the next five years.
steps.why: Your relationship manager gets the file KBC already built.
steps.result: Meeting booked with your relationship manager.
